countyDirectory.name: ADAD Accredited Special Treatment Facilities & Therapeutic Living Programs — listed by island (Hawai'i Department of Health, PDF, revised September 2025)

narrNote: No Hawai'i affiliate appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched 2026-10-22), so the field is left null per doctrine. Hawai'i has no NARR affiliate chapter; ADAD itself accredits substance-use special treatment facilities and therapeutic living programs directly (see countyDirectory).
notes: ADAD is Hawai'i's single state authority for substance use services; its own page publishes phone (808) 692-7506 and directs people needing treatment to Hawai'i CARES. Hawai'i CARES is administered by ADAD and managed by CARE Hawaii, Inc.; it is the state's coordinated entry system for SUD treatment and recovery support and its 24/7 crisis line (808-832-3100 on O'ahu, 1-800-753-6879 toll-free from neighbor islands; also reachable via 988). Hawai'i is organized by island/county, so ADAD's accreditation list — organized by island — serves as the local directory. Aloha United Way 211 is Hawai'i's only statewide helpline (dial 211, local 808-275-2000, toll-free 1-877-275-6569, per its homepage). The Med-QUEST FAQ documents QUEST Integration (Medicaid) coverage including substance abuse treatment programs and behavioral health services. HHHRC provides peer-led navigation and harm reduction services statewide; NAMI Hawaii runs peer-led Peer-to-Peer classes and Connection recovery support groups by island. Every URL in this file was fetched and content-checked on 2026-10-22.
